thread:
jamal: Quick heads-up: staging pen-test scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. Need an evidence escrow workflow: short-lived presigned S3 + per-object KMS-wrapped DEKs, plus proof the assessor can only decrypt those DEKs. No DB dumps.
emily: Ops manifest schema: object, sha256, wrapped_dek_kms_key, presign_ttl, grant_arn, signature_method. Keep manifest small and machine-parseable.
tanya: Ops will deliver a 1h rolling log slice and a single 24h slice for any flagged auth endpoints. We'll sanitize (PII removal, IP obfuscation to /24, strip query strings). No secrets or full SQL dumps.
mike: Implementation note: KMS grants can't be pinned to a single ciphertext id. Workaround: generate a unique bundle DEK, encrypt it with the CMK using EncryptionContext {"pt-bundle":"<id>"}, and create a grant constrained to that EncryptionContextSubset. Assessor can only decrypt DEKs for that bundle.
jamal: Good. Also prefer manifest signatures via KMS Sign (asymmetric CMK) instead of GPG for rotation and centralized auditability.
kms-bot: KMS guidance: create-grant supports EncryptionContextSubset constraints. Example:
aws kms create-grant \\ 
  --key-id alias/staging-logs \\ 
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-auditor \\ 
  --operations Decrypt \\ 
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"pt-bundle":"b123"}
emily: Operational constraints: escrow S3 bucket lifecycle -> 7 days; S3 access logs to a separate locked bucket; enable CloudTrail data events for the S3 prefix and include KMS events for the CMK. Add manifest.sha256 and manifest.signature fields.
mike: I'll run tools/pt_push.sh tonight: 1) create per-bundle DEK, 2) wrap with CMK + EncryptionContext, 3) upload bundle, 4) create KMS-Sign for manifest, 5) create grant, 6) presign object for 1h, 7) post URLs and grant ARN here.
jamal: Retest cadence: 14 days after remediation preferred. If a remediation increases privileges or attack surface, freeze deploys for the impacted service and escalate in #incidents.
tanya: I'll run sanitization check and approve the sample 30 minutes before the start time. Will not hand off until security signs off.
auditor: Please include assessor contact and allowed operations (Decrypt-only via grant) in the manifest so we have the scope recorded.
kms-bot: Automation note: schedule a revoke for the created grant after TTL; capture KMS Decrypt CloudTrail events and S3 GetObject events during the window and attach an access snapshot to the post-run report.
jamal: Thanks all. We'll run a 30-minute post-mortem in #eng-security the day after to capture any gaps and update the playbook. React :thumbsup: to ack.
emily: :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup: will post presign + grant ARN when done.
tanya: :thumbsup: will run sanitization at T-30.
